per_case.answer_text:
Diamond membership gives you access to extra or enhanced features. In particular, Diamond holders can:

- earn referral rewards (50% of a referred member’s Diamond payments for the first year; paid in CHAT or ICP depending on how the referred member buys),
- create public Groups,
- create public and/or private Communities,
- create Gated Groups and Gated Communities,
- make video and voice calls,
- make or accept Swap Offers for P2P Swaps, and
- access any other features we may make available to Diamond members from time to time.

You can upgrade to Diamond to get these extra or enhanced features (see the Diamond feature comparison and upgrade page).
